description: Group A - Reliability & self-healing in the Autopilot loop (src/autopilot/loop.ts, plus overlay states). A1 auto-retry with self-healing refs, A2 post-action settle detection, A3 loop-detection / stuck guard. All additive: RunResult/StepRecord keep their existing shape; only NEW optional fields and a NEW outcome value 'stuck' are added. Reuse the Narrator/overlay for surfacing. Depends on FEAT-001 config knobs.
steps: A1 self-healing refs: in loop.ts execute(), for the targeted ops (CLICK/TYPE_TEXT/SELECT/HOVER) wrap the Playwright action in a bounded retry (up to config selfHealRetries, threaded via RunGoalOptions.selfHealRetries, default 1). On failure that looks like a stale/missing ref (locator throws / count()===0 / timeout), re-run capture(page) and re-resolve the SAME target by accessible name + role from the fresh snapshot (match the original control's name+role captured before the first attempt), then retry via session.resolveRef on the new ref. If re-resolution finds no match, rethrow the original error. Surface each retry on the overlay (narrator.toast('Re-resolving stale element...', 'uncertain') + narrator.log). Record retries on the StepRecord via a NEW optional field `retries?: number` and a note. Add a helper resolveByNameRole(session, page, name, role) that captures and finds the best match. Keep execute() the ONLY IO function.

A2 settle detection: after each executed action (in the loop, not for terminal DONE/BLOCKED), when config settleProbe is on, run a lightweight bounded probe (add a method to BrowserSession, e.g. probeSettle(page, {timeoutMs}) that reads document.readyState, current URL, and a short-lived MutationObserver mutation count over a small window like 250-400ms, all via page.evaluate with its own internal timeout - NO networkidle, NO slowMo). Return {changed: boolean, urlChanged: boolean, mutations: number}. Feed the result into the loop: narrator.setState/status 'Waiting for page to settle...' during the probe and a toast 'No change detected' when changed is false. Store the probe result on the StepRecord via NEW optional field `settled?: boolean` (true when a change was observed). Keep it fast and bounded (default ~400ms cap).

A3 loop-detection / stuck guard: when config loopDetection is on, after appending each StepRecord compute a signature for the current step = url + sorted control-name+role set signature + the decision (operation+target+value). Keep a rolling window of the last `loopWindow` signatures. When the last `loopWindow` signatures are all identical (same URL + same control-set signature + same decision), bail early: push a terminal StepRecord with operation 'BLOCKED' detail 'BLOCKED (stuck: no progress detected)', set a NEW RunOutcome value 'stuck', surface a distinct overlay state (narrator.setState('error', 'Stuck - not progressing') + toast) and break. Add 'stuck' to the RunOutcome union in loop.ts and handle it in the final summary/coloring (treat like blocked for verification messaging but keep the distinct outcome string). Ensure renderRunResult in run_goal.ts still renders it (it prints result.outcome generically, so just confirm).

Thread the three new options through RunGoalOptions (selfHealRetries?, settleProbe?, loopDetection?, loopWindow?) and from src/tools/run_goal.ts RunGoalContext + src/server.ts (from config). Defaults must preserve current behavior when the knobs are at their defaults except where the feature is intended to be on (settleProbe/loopDetection default true - ensure existing autopilot tests still pass because a settle probe that observes a normal navigation and a loop that completes in a few steps do not change outcomes; if any existing test would flip, adjust the probe to be purely observational - it must NEVER change the decision path or outcome except A3's explicit stuck bail).

Add fixtures + tests. New fixtures under test/fixtures/: `stale-ref.html` (a page where clicking a button removes/replaces a second target element and re-renders it with the same accessible name+role, so the first-captured ref goes stale); `dead-button.html` (a button with no handler - a no-op click, no DOM change / no URL change) and reuse an existing navigating fixture (e.g. nav-a.html linking to nav-b.html) for the settle 'changed' case; `loop-trap.html` (a page whose controls never change and where a rogue engine keeps choosing the same CLICK, to exercise A3). Add test/autopilot-reliability.test.ts (real headless chromium, StubEngine or small custom engines) asserting: (A1) a self-healing retry re-resolves a stale ref and the action ultimately succeeds, with StepRecord.retries>=1; (A2) settle probe reports changed=false on the dead button and changed=true / urlChanged=true on a navigating action; (A3) a rogue always-same-CLICK engine on loop-trap.html bails with outcome 'stuck' well before maxSteps (assert transcript length < maxSteps and last op BLOCKED with stuck detail).
acceptance_criteria: RunOutcome union additively includes 'stuck'; existing outcome strings unchanged. StepRecord gains only OPTIONAL fields (retries?, settled?); existing fields and their meanings unchanged.
A rogue engine that repeats the identical decision on a static page ends with outcome 'stuck' and a transcript shorter than maxSteps (does not burn the full budget).
The settle probe returns changed=false for a no-op/dead click and changed=true (or urlChanged=true) for a navigating click, and never uses networkidle or slowMo.
A stale-ref targeted action re-resolves by name+role and succeeds, recording retries>=1 on the step, with a retry surfaced on the overlay log/toast.
All existing autopilot/safety/benchmark tests still pass unchanged (no outcome regressions from the always-on settle probe / loop detection).
verification: Run `npx vitest run test/autopilot-reliability.test.ts` and confirm the A1/A2/A3 assertions pass headless.
Run `npm run test` and confirm the full suite still passes with the 3 pre-existing skips.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm clean.
